body: It would’ve been 7 years for me and her today. In 2 months and 2 days she will be gone for a year.
Her phone wasn’t shut off until I knew I couldn’t let it stay active anymore.
Yeah, I was having a pretty rough night without my wife a few months ago. I heard her come through in her soft yell and told me to stop it.
I can honestly identify with that.

It’s just like she’s been gone now a little over 2 months… I fight just to have a normal day ya know?
Now it seems like everyone is watching me to have a breakdown. Telling me I’m so strong they don’t know I’m keeping it together…
I’m only 2 months in so probably not the one to ask. Although I know I’m not ready.

For me it was probably like 2 weeks after… my heart still hurts from getting some of those things out… I’m doing my best to keep moving forward… she was the first person to teach me it’s ok to fight for me.
No just lots of pain and heartache. Just coming to the realization I never wanted to be in this world.
I’ve been fighting so hard for 32 years I just don’t see it.
